title: Correct charge q
description: Essential: Student's final answer for the charge q must be mgh²/(2kQ).

title: Correct acceleration at B
description: Essential: Student's final answer for the acceleration at point B must be 7g, with correct direction (upward) stated or implied.

title: Force balance at A
description: Important: Student must apply Newton's second law at point A, equating net force (mg minus electrostatic force) to m*(g/2).

title: Force balance at B
description: Important: Student must apply Newton's second law at point B, equating net force (electrostatic force minus mg) to m*a_B.

title: Correct potential difference
description: Important: Student's final answer for the potential difference U_AB must be -3kQ/(2h).

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Student must use the work-energy theorem or conservation of energy, relating work by gravity and electric field to the change in kinetic energy (zero).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns the direction of the electrostatic force (attractive/repulsive) leading to wrong signs in the force equations.

title: Incorrect distance substitution
description: Pitfall: Student uses h instead of 0.25h for the distance at point B in Coulomb's law, or makes an algebraic error in solving the simultaneous equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student performs a dimensional analysis to verify the units of their final answers for q and potential difference.
